newsitem.title: UK: PRESS DIGEST - London Evening Standard - Dec 12.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - London Evening Standard - Dec 12.

text.p: Prepared for Reuters by The Broadcast Monitoring Company

The government's law reform body has announced radical proposals to make drivers pay for hospital treatment of those they injure. If plans to make offenders pay for their victim's treatment on the National Health Service go ahead, insurance premiums are expected to rise.
According to a new report Eurotunnel's complex financial restructuring, unveiled in October may be inadequate to restore the company to financial health following last month's Channel tunnel fire.
U.S. SETS AGENDA AS BRITAIN AWAITS INFLATION FIGURES
British markets will today take their lead from the U.S. despite political upheaval at home and inflation figures out today.
UNICHEM AND ASDA MOOT HEALTH TIE-UP
Under the government's latest Primary Care Bill UniChem and ASDA are set to grab a significant share of new health centre development programmes.
AMP SPELLS OUT PLAN FOR LISTING TO PAY FOR BUYS
AMP, Australia's largest life insurer and money manager, today spelled out its plans for a stock market flotation in order to finance its aggressive acquisition strategy.
